i have been out of this for awhile, could someone explain what ggrevolt is about, and why it split from HQ?

/ggrevolt/ is an unhinged free speech board with 3 rules: no dox, no spam, nothing illegal.

Everyone hates it because you can go start a thread "@cat-dildo is a cunt and deserves to die", and it's not going to get deleted and no one is going to get banned. If you believe in freedom of speech, you have to accept the fact that others will have speech that you don't like.

The split happened back in May when Acid Man, the BO of /gamergatehq/, decided to "purge" his board of "dramafags", boycott threads, and basically anyone who disagreed with him. We went to /pol/ and discussed making our own board where nothing was banned, and then we made it happen.
